programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    frames = []
    for color in range(1, 10):
        cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
        if not cells:
            continue
        r0 = min(r for r, c in cells); r1 = max(r for r, c in cells)
        c0 = min(c for r, c in cells); c1 = max(c for r, c in cells)
        if r1-r0 < 2 or c1-c0 < 2:
            continue
        perimeter = ([(r0,c) for c in range(c0,c1+1)] + [(r1,c) for c in range(c0,c1+1)] +
                     [(r,c0) for r in range(r0+1,r1)] + [(r,c1) for r in range(r0+1,r1)])
        if all(grid[r][c] == color for r,c in perimeter):
            frames.append((color,r0,r1,c0,c1))
    out = [[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    frame_cells = set()
    for border, r0,r1,c0,c1 in frames:
        for r,c in ([(r0,c) for c in range(c0,c1+1)] + [(r1,c) for c in range(c0,c1+1)] +
                    [(r,c0) for r in range(r0+1,r1)] + [(r,c1) for r in range(r0+1,r1)]):
            out[r][c] = border
            frame_cells.add((r,c))
    counts = Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
                     if grid[r][c] and (r,c) not in frame_cells)
    for border,r0,r1,c0,c1 in frames:
        interior = [(r,c) for r in range(r0+1,r1) for c in range(c0+1,c1)]
        pattern = [(r,c) for r,c in interior if (r-r0-1+c-c0-1)%2 == 0]
        matches = [color for color,n in counts.items() if n == len(pattern)]
        if len(matches) == 1:
            fill = matches[0]
        else:
            raise ValueError((border, len(pattern), counts, matches))
        for r,c in pattern:
            out[r][c] = fill
    return out
'''
p=programs/'task-cb58ec9e.py'; p.write_text(code)
print(p)
